messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Does anyone know what the unit is for the timenum column is in the ms5.outraw document is?
parts:
Hi Lauren,

timenum are seconds elapsed since 1970-1-1. You can convert these to readable timestamps with as.POSIXlt or as POSIXct functions, don't forget to specify argument tz as well. If you tell GGIR to store the time series as RData file this conversing will be done for you.

I now see I forgot to document this in the vignette section "Time series output files", but that paragraph should explain everything else you need to know about the time series files.

Best, Vincent
